title: Not a mockup.
description: The parts this site is built from — its tokens, motion and accessibility rules, running live. Every client gets a system like this, designed for their product and handed over with the code. Change a setting and watch it respond.
footnote: A look inside how we build interfaces — not a component library for sale. Each project gets its own system, designed around its brand. Reduced-motion and RTL behaviour come built in — switch your OS setting or the site language and re-test.

controls.tiltNote: Tilt self-disables on touch devices and under reduced motion.

demo.cardBody: Every surface in the system carries its own elevation, border, and motion rules.
